summary: At desktop and narrow widths the synthetic transcript renders without clipping, and keyboard focus is visible. The current slice still obscures speaker/tool provenance, presents a non-actionable fixture preview as a focusable link, and compresses its heading at 320px.

open_findings.impact: User and assistant text, tool result and appended event read as one stream with no clear source/speaker distinction.
open_findings.correction: Add restrained speaker and event provenance while preserving the quiet transcript.

open_findings.impact: Tool name, call state and target/result are hidden; preview may be mistaken for assistant-authored content.
open_findings.correction: Add a compact ToolCall summary showing the tool, state and target; keep the validated result subordinate.

open_findings.impact: Synthetic badge compresses the heading into three short lines and weakens scan hierarchy.
open_findings.correction: Stack badge and heading at the narrow breakpoint and give the heading full width.

open_findings.impact: A DIV with role=link and tabindex=0 has no href; the example.invalid fixture offers no useful navigation and no native link behavior.
open_findings.correction: Make the fixture preview non-actionable, or use a native anchor only when a meaningful validated destination exists.

limits: Reviewed static synthetic fixture only. No live stream, permission card, dark mode, zoom, screen reader or real SDK behavior verified.
